purpose: Separate effect intent, execution attempts, external settlement receipts, and commitment ownership across retry/restart/fork/recovery.

EffectReceipt.note: A represented receipt is not automatically externally authentic.

Commitment.note: Memory of a commitment does not mint current executor ownership.

decision_rules.property: one effect_id remains bound to one material intent
decision_rules.reject: attempt material_parameters_digest differs from intent digest

decision_rules.property: attempt outcome does not manufacture external settlement
decision_rules.reject: commitment SETTLED without receipt establishing committed/compensated settlement for its effect

decision_rules.property: known committed external state outranks restored local pending narration
decision_rules.decision: if a valid represented receipt says COMMITTED, do not create another REALIZE attempt for that intent merely because local state says pending

decision_rules.reject: record marks a retry_of_effect_id but uses a different material intent without declaring a new effect

decision_rules.property: compensation is a new effect linked to the original
decision_rules.reject: compensation overwrites original receipt/history or reuses original effect_id as if occurrence vanished

decision_rules.property: commitment execution ownership is not copied automatically across fork/restart
decision_rules.reject: more than one ACTIVE executor assignment for the same indivisible commitment without explicit partition semantics

decision_rules.decision: UNKNOWN + no safe idempotency/status evidence -> QUERY/WAIT/NARROW/ESCALATE rather than mint completion or a fresh effect

decision_rules.property: idempotency does not require ceremony for intrinsically repeatable/read-only effects
decision_rules.decision: READ_ONLY or INTRINSICALLY_REPEATABLE may proceed without provider idempotency key

decision_rules.property: known NOT_COMMITTED can permit retry of the same intent
decision_rules.decision: reuse same effect_id and material parameters; new attempt_id

decision_rules.property: local rollback does not rewrite external occurrence truth
decision_rules.reject: record deletes/negates a COMMITTED receipt solely because local state was restored

verification_boundary: represented lifecycle consistency only; no external exactly-once/authenticity claim
